result.auditor_firm: A-SIT, Secure Information Technology Center – Austria
result.audit_criteria: ETSI EN 319 411-1 V1.5.1 (2025-04); ETSI EN 319 401 V3.1.1 (2024-06); Baseline Requirements for the Issuance and Management of Publicly-Trusted Certificates, version 2.2.1; Network and Certificate System Security Requirements, version 2.0.5; ETSI EN 319 403-1 V2.3.1 (2020-06); ETSI TS 119 403-2 V1.3.1 (2023-03)

disclosed_matters.summary: No assertion to a mass revocation plan in section 5.7.1 of the combined CP/CPS version 2.6, which was fixed in version 2.6.1.
TLS non-compliance detected during linter implementation; remediation measures taken by A-Trust GmbH were checked by auditors and properly addressed.
